variants.specifics: Brackenford: Ulric, an old shepherd at the edge of the Ashwood, puts a price on Greyjaw, the wolf taking his sheep.

offer.speaker: Ulric
offer.text:
Good day, kind sir. I presume you've come about the reward.

There's a fine purse on the head of Greyjaw -- the biggest wolf in the Ashwood. He and his ragged pack have been taking my sheep for weeks.

Mind yourself, you wouldn't want to be jumped by those snarling brutes.

reminder.speaker: Ulric
reminder.text: That Greyjaw is still loose! I lost another lamb last night!

completion.speaker: Ulric
completion.text:
Ho, there! My dogs started barking, so I came out to look.

You have single handed slain the dreaded Greyjaw! Most impressive! You have my deepest respect, kind sir! That old wolf has been raiding Brackenford for weeks! I'll take his hide from here. We will all sleep sounder with that savage brute gone for good!

And here is your reward, kind sir -- 100 in gold!

journal.text: Rid the Ashwood of the wolf Greyjaw.

variants.writer: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), writer 1

variants.specifics: Ostrum: Pellox, who buys ore, had his strongbox emptied by a gang of thieves and pays to see them stopped.

offer.speaker: Pellox
offer.text:
Truth is, trade has been rather poor lately. Ten days ago, thieves broke into my shop and emptied the strongbox.

I don't suppose my silver will ever come back, but I'd like nothing better than seeing those crooks pay for what they did.

I'll gladly reward whoever puts a stop to them.

reminder.speaker: Pellox
reminder.text: Are those thieves still running loose? I won't rest easy till they're caught!

completion.speaker: Pellox
completion.text:
So the thieves have got what was coming to them! Good work, lad! The whole town can rest easier knowing those crooks won't be sneaking their grubby hands into our strongboxes!

And here's your reward... 150 in gold! You'll always be welcome at Pellox's shop!

journal.text: Hunt down the thieves who robbed Pellox.

variants.specifics: Vell: The Trolls broke into Hesper's hut and her pet turtle Mortimer is shut in the back room with them.

offer.speaker: Hesper
offer.text:
Oh, please help me, stranger! The Trolls have broken into my hut and my poor turtle, Mortimer, is stuck in the back room with them!

Save him and I'll be grateful to you for the rest of my days!

reminder.speaker: Hesper
reminder.text: Whatever you find in there is yours to keep! Only hurry and save Mortimer!

completion.speaker: Hesper
completion.text:
Oh, thank heavens, he's alive! However can I thank you for your courage?!

Eh? What's that? Heaps and heaps of gold? Well... if gold is what you want, then please accept this as a token of my gratitude.

journal.text: Rescue Mortimer the Talking Turtle from Hesper's hut in Vell.

variants.specifics: Tarnhold: Wendle, sentry at the jammed drawbridge, had his helmet taken by the Urchins of the den under the wall while he napped on watch.

offer.speaker: Wendle
offer.text:
Sorry, mate, the drawbridge is jammed! Only way to the south road is under the wall, through the Urchin den. But, if you go that way, mate, stay sharp! The Urchins swiped my helmet while I was napping on watch!

If you get it back, mate, I'll give you a damn fine spell book.

reminder.speaker: Wendle
reminder.text: Got my helmet yet, mate? I feel naked out here without it!

completion.speaker: Wendle
completion.text: My helmet! I figured it was gone for good! I owe you one, mate. Here's the spell book, like I promised.

journal.text: Recover the drawbridge sentry's helmet from the Urchins and give it back.

variants.specifics: Tolvin: Grella, a goat-keeper's wife, wants the Wolves of the Fenwood killed for taking her goats.

offer.speaker: Grella
offer.text:
Sir! Help me please! A pack of wild Wolves just came out of the Fenwood, the forest south of here and dragged off almost all of my goats! They even took my best milk goat!

Please kill those Wolves and I'll give you a reward!

reminder.speaker: Grella
reminder.text: Oh why aren't you hunting them? There won't be a goat left by morning!

completion.speaker: Grella
completion.text: Bless you, brave stranger! Please take these for your trouble!

journal.text: Kill the Wolves that are taking Grella's goats.

variants.specifics: Olvane: Chancellor Vimbly has fled his bedchamber, which is full of bats, and pays to have them driven out.

offer.speaker: Vimbly
offer.text:
These wretched bats are the bane of my life! The porters swung brooms at them, but they keep flying back in! My last hope is that you can somehow chase the bats out for good!

The bats are in my bedchamber, up there, behind the green door. Please, do be careful.

reminder.speaker: Vimbly
reminder.text: I will not set foot in there till the bats are gone! Swat them! Squash them! Hurry before they breed again!

completion.speaker: Vimbly
completion.text:
Brave Adventurer, you have my deepest gratitude! You have earned the title of Friend of the College. Brunt and the other guards will be told that you may enter the College library as you please.

Take this gold for your trouble. I insist.

journal.text: Drive the bats out of Chancellor Vimbly's bedchamber.

variants.specifics: Fort Ostkar: Haskel the goatherd wants the White Wolves of the Howling Crag killed after they raided the goat pens.

offer.speaker: Haskel
offer.text:
Damn! Where were you, lad!? The White Wolves came down on the goat pens and we'd have lost every last goat to them if Tolvar's archers hadn't opened fire from the wall at the final moment!

But in all the confusion, the pack dragged off half my herd, leaving a smashed fence the least of my worries! The whole fort will starve this winter if the herd is lost!

You must go where the pack ran off to, west to the Howling Crag! Kill those wolves or we are finished!

reminder.speaker: Haskel
reminder.text: I'm sure those wolves will be back for more! Hurry!

completion.speaker: Haskel
completion.text:
In better other days, the whole fort would feast in honor of the slaying of that pack! Well done, lad! But now we must stop the wicked Kragan once and for all.

Here, accept these as a token of my thanks for your brave deed!

journal.text: Climb the Howling Crag and kill the White Wolves.

variants.specifics: Orvak: Foreman Kessick wants the giant wasps and bats driven out of the Ironvein Mine.

offer.speaker: Foreman Kessick
offer.text:
Where in blazes have you been!? We're in dreadful trouble!

Monstrous giant wasps and shrieking bats from the deep tunnels have swarmed the Ironvein Mine. Good miners have perished defending the ore of Orvak!

Please, I'm begging you! Drive those beasts out of my mine and I promise you a generous reward.

This key opens the gate at the mine entrance.

I also have a spell book which might come in handy.

reminder.speaker: Foreman Kessick
reminder.text: Come back once the mine is clear and you'll be paid well.

completion.speaker: Foreman Kessick
completion.text:
Now that's what I call a hero! My sincerest thanks.

While you were down in the mine, driving out the beasts, Wendril stopped by asking after you. He said he'd wait for you at the Great Forge -- just south of here.

And before you go, here's some gold as your reward.

journal.text: Kill or drive off all the beasts in the Ironvein Mine.

variants.specifics: Torvel Cross: Morlo the cider farmer wants the Imp in the old well behind his barn killed, the Imp having riled up the rats; he pays with a letter for Hask the Ferryman.

offer.speaker: Morlo
offer.text:
Good! My family presses the best cider in Torvel Cross. Sadly, a nasty little Imp has moved into the old well behind our barn. He has riled up the rats and now they bite anyone who goes near the barn.

Go kill the Imp and when you get back, I'll write you a letter for Hask the Ferryman.

Here, take this iron key, it opens the barn door.

reminder.speaker: Morlo
reminder.text: Courage, one small Imp is nothing to fear. Come back once he's been done away with.

completion.speaker: Morlo
completion.text:
Wonderful! The Imp is dead!

Here is your letter. Give it to Hask the Ferryman and he'll take you over the river. Good luck!

journal.text: Kill the Imp stirring up the rats on Morlo's farm.

variants.specifics: Corvale: Mobb the shepherd has lost his sheepdog Bodger to the wolves that moved into the woods by his pasture.

offer.speaker: Mobb
offer.text:
Filthy, greedy beasts! The wolves just moved into the woods by my pasture and are already making a terrible nuisance of themselves!

My name is Mobb. I am looking for my sheepdog, Bodger. I fear he ran off into a wolf den near here.

If you can find Bodger and bring him home, I would gladly give you my old bow. Come along, I'll take you as far as that miserable den past the north pasture.

reminder.speaker: Mobb
reminder.text: Any sign of Bodger yet? Oh my, I fear for the poor fellow.

completion.speaker: Mobb
completion.text:
Bodger's collar! Something dreadful must have happened to him.

Well, you have shown those wolves who is master. Maybe you would make a fine shepherd yourself. Hmmm... Yes.

Follow me back to my cottage. When you are ready, take the bow and quiver by the door. They are yours. We have a great deal to do before the Ogres come down from the hills.

journal.text: Find out what became of Mobb's sheepdog.
